item.title: Madras High Court grants anti-piracy injunction to protect Rani Mukerji’s Mardaani 3 ahead of release
item.description: In a significant development ahead of the theatrical release of Mardaani 3, the Madras High Court on Wednesday granted an ad-interim anti-piracy injunction to safeguard the copyright of the upcoming Hindi film starring Rani Mukerji.
